plans for the first open-source “instruction-tuned” language model.

Michael SpencerOct 29, 2022∙ Paid3Share

Hey Guys, 

You are reading A.I. Supremacy Premium, 

So I’m bringing you yet another startup scoop from the world of A.I. Labs. A group of AI researchers have joined forces to train and publicly release instruction-tuned large language models.

CarperAI, along with partners EleutherAI, Scale AI, Multi, Humanloop and Hugging Face, plans to release a chinchilla-optimal large language model. Their announcement was back on October 19th, 2022 and I didn’t see it, it hasn’t been covered much.
